request.description: All templates, filterable by `key`, `channel`, `locale` and `active` (`true` / `false`). Message templates per key, channel (`sms`, `email`, `push`) and language. Placeholders must be ones the sender provides (`availableParams`); sign-in and consent codes must keep `{{code}}`, staff invitations `{{token}}` and consent requests `{{link}}`. Email and push need a subject, SMS has none. A changed SMS text that already has a DLT template id needs its new id in the same change. The English template is the fallback and stays active. Compliance officers manage templates; ops leads and support read them. Staff context.

response.name: 200 OK
